layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game map: chunky simple rounded shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, soft slightly desaturated colours, light from the top left, clean edges.

layers.text: Camera: seen from the front and slightly above, like a vegetable garden on a strategy game map; drawn on a fully transparent background; nothing is cropped at the top or the bottom.

Class: crops for a square farm tile of a strategy game map: big plump simple plants growing in straight horizontal rows, each row on its own long narrow strip of tilled brown soil; a dark brown outline (never black), no box, no border and no frame. Everything that is not a plant or its strip of soil is empty and transparent.

layers.text: Subject: one single long narrow raised bed of tilled warm-brown soil running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with one row of five plump round golden wheat sheaves standing on it side by side, soft straw gold with a darker gold shadow; the bed and its plants are low, about half the image height, with empty transparent space above and below. Crops and soil only.
